title: Synthetic invoice lure review
source_label: Training scenario — sanitized mail gateway summary
narrative: A synthetic invoice-themed phishing message may have directed a training user to a documentation-domain credential page. The record includes a high-confidence phishing theme and requires authorized mail and identity telemetry review.

evidence.summary: Synthetic gateway training record notes an invoice-style subject and a documentation-domain link.
Synthetic analyst note records that the training recipient reported the message without accessing the link.
